original: 一日は二十四時間ある。

en.text: There are twenty-four hours in a day.

indices: 一日(いちにち) は 二 十 四(よ) 時間 有る{ある}

original: 十、十一、十二、十三、十四、十五、十六、十七、十八、十九、二十。

en.text: Ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty.

original: この年の正月は十四日から十七日まで四日間の雪を見た。

en.text: In the first month of that year, I saw that it snowed for four days from the 14th until the 17th.
In January of that year, we saw snow for four days, from the fourteenth to the seventeenth.
